---
title: Pumpkin Loaves
tags: ['pumpkin', 'dessert', 'sweet', 'cheesefare']
date: 2023-02-24
author: kylertk
---

- ⏲️ Prep time: 20 min
- 🍳 Cook time: 1 hr 15 min
- 🍽️ Servings: 2 loaves

## Ingredients

- 2 cups flour
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 1 teaspoon ground cloves
- 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
- 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg
- 1/2 teaspoon grated ginger
- 2 cups sugar
- 3/4 cup butter
- 2 eggs
- 1 can (1 lb) pumpkin

## Directions

1. Grease 2 loaf pans or cover with parchment paper, then preheat oven to 325°F
2. Sift flour with all other dry ingredients (optional)
3. Beat sugar and butter
4. Add eggs to sugar/butter mixture, one at a time
5. Beat in pureed pumpkin
6. Whisk in flour and other dry ingrients
7. Add batter to loaf pans and bake for ~ 1 hour 15 minutes
